thread:
Marta: kicking off migration window now, quiesce at 21:00 UTC — short maintenance window, no user-facing downtime expected.
Kai: ack, I will pin the canary service to v2 and watch lock stats.
deploy-bot: deploy started: migration/schema-shim-2026-03 v2 -> canary 
Sam: FYI this backfill touches users.row_metadata, small rows but it hits users_idx_meta during index updates
Leah: suggestion: create a shadow index and run index population in batches, then swap. keeps locks brief.
Kai: operational plan: 1) pin service to v2 2) create shadow index 3) run batched backfill (100/req) 4) perform index swap 5) unpin
Marta: if any lock waits exceed 30s, abort and trigger rollback. @deploy-bot, add an escape-hatch flag. :warning:
deploy-bot: escape-hatch flag set: migration-escape=true
Sam: sharing small pg_locks snippet observed during dry-run:
```
pid  | mode             | granted
1234 | AccessShareLock  | t
5678 | RowExclusiveLock | f
```
Kai: good catch — we'll throttle to 100 rows per batch for first 1h and monitor for lock escalation.
Jordan: release notes draft: "Schema: shadow index + batched backfill for row_metadata. No downtime expected." Can someone append changelog? @Leah
Leah: adding changelog entry now -> /changelog PR #452 :white_check_mark:
Marta: starting batch-run: `./run_backfill --batch=100 --workers=4`
Sam: first batch result: 100 rows, ~0.8s/row average, no lock escalation so far. continuing.
Kai: monitoring metrics: p99 latency stable, lock_waits spike = 0. Keeping service pinned to v2 for +10m.
Marta: HOLD — anomaly at 21:12 UTC: one worker hung and retried twice, remaining jobs queued. Aborting pending batches and rolling back index swap steps.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: migration/schema-shim-2026-03 -> previous-stable 
Sam: verification: processed 2,400/15,000 rows before abort. Will collect stack traces and logs, pausing further runs.
Marta: next steps: (1) debug hung worker (collect core/logs), (2) add exponential backoff + job watchdog, (3) rehearse escape-hatch in a dry-run.
Jordan: updated release notes to reflect aborted backfill and re-run plan for next window.
Leah: moving detailed RCA discussion to #postmortems and will upload logs :memo:
Marta: thanks all — re-scheduling final attempt for Tue 21:00 UTC after fixes. Please ack. :thumbsup:
